expo.name: Omnigit
expo.//orientation: Every orientation, because a build can only lock to orientations it declares. The app still stands upright everywhere except the code screens - see src/ui/rotation.ts, which locks it at launch and unlocks it only while a file or a diff is in front.

plugins.//: Playback only - the assistant's opening chime. So no microphone permission on either platform, no background audio on iOS, and no media-playback service on Android: none of it is used, and each would be questioned at review.

experiments.//typedRoutes: Off deliberately. The SDK 57 generator walks the whole module graph rather than the route tree, so it emits every imported file as a route (`/../ui/diff`) and never collapses `repo/index.tsx` to `/repo` - which makes correct hrefs fail to typecheck and wrong ones pass. Worth turning back on once the generated file lists only real routes; nothing in the app depends on it being off.
